answer_1.quote: We evaluate BiGLM for task-specific fine-tuning scenarios with the following dataset, i.e., MNLI and SQuAD for understanding tasks, XSUM and MSQG (MicroSoft Question Generation) for generation tasks. ... a subset containing several instances sampled from heldout generation tasks including WIKI-AUTO for text simplification, Quora Question Pairs (QQP) for paraphrase generation, and PersonaChat for dialogue generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries, questions, paraphrases, dialogues, and simplified text

answer_2.quote: As for the evaluation metrics, we follow to adopt ROUGE-1/2/L for XSUM, BLEU-4, Rouge-L and METEOR (Lavie and Agarwal, 2007) for MSQG. ... We report BLEU and Distinct to measure the n-gram level precision and the diversity of generated texts.
